# fjordrun_vpc (Data Source)

A private network, with its members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "vpc_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_vpc" "backend" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  id      = var.vpc_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Private network ID.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `members` (Attributes List) Its environments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `name` (String) Name.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last change.
